fields.weather: Steady moderate rain, 48°F, light south wind. 2 inches fell overnight on the Sugar Camp Run basin north of campus.
fields.load: Pre-dawn: residence halls asleep. 680 residents in Riverside Hall and 210 in the Sugar Run Apartments. 08:00 classes are on the schedule.
fields.staffing: Overnight coverage only: the central plant is on its night shift. Day staff have not arrived and no EOC is open.
fields.narration: EXERCISE, EXERCISE, EXERCISE. It is 05:30 EDT on Thursday, March 25, 2027, at Marlowe State University in Marlowe, Athens County, Ohio. A steady moderate rain is falling, it is 48 degrees with a light south wind, and 2 inches of rain fell overnight on the Sugar Camp Run basin north of campus. The residence halls are asleep, with 680 residents in Riverside Hall and 210 in the Sugar Run Apartments. The central plant is on its night shift and 08:00 classes are on the schedule. The campus is at Level 3 Monitoring, no EOC is open, and the Facilities dashboard is up with all systems normal. Seats, the clock on the projector is the exercise clock, and the SimCell at the control table plays everyone outside this room.
